name: Annecy
tagline: Canals, a turquoise lake and the Alps of Savoie
summary: Annecy is a pastel old town of canals and flower boxes on one of Europe's cleanest lakes. Photograph the island-prison Palais de l'Isle, cycle or swim around Lake Annecy, take the boat to Talloires, and drive up the Semnoz or the Col de la Forclaz for paragliders and big Alpine views.
seasonNote: June to September for swimming; the Tuesday, Friday and Sunday markets run year round.
arrival: Trains from Paris take 3h40; Geneva Airport is 45 minutes by bus or car.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; bike the lakeside path or take the lake boats.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; service is included in prices, so round up only for good service.
foodTip: Reblochon (made nearby), lake fish like féra, and Savoie wines.
buyTip: Reblochon and Tomme de Savoie from the old-town market.
baseArea: Vieille Ville or near the lake
